paite: Peter, Jesu Khrist sawltak in, Pontus gam, Galatia gam, Kappadosia gam, Asia gam Bithinia leh gam tuamtuam a mikhual dalhzakte kiang ah;
heading: Chibai Bukna

paite: Pa Pathian theihkholh bang a Jesu Khrist thumanna leh sisan theh tang ding a Kha hihtuamna tungtawn a tel a omte kiang ah hehpihna leh khamuanna hihkhan in om hen.
I Toupa Jesu Khrist leh Pa Pathian phat in om hen! Ama'n azahngaihna thupitak bang zel in, misi lak a kipan Jesu Khrist thohnawnna ziak in lametna hing mu ding in ahon piang thaksak nawn hi;
heading: Lametna Hing

paite: goutan setheilou, nin baang lou, tul thei lou, van a nou a ding a sit muhna ding in;
hotdamna, hun nanung a lang ding a zohsa mu ding in, ginna ziak in Pathian thilhihtheihna a ven na hi uhi.
Tu in ze-etna chiteng ziak in hun sawt lou lungkham tadih mah le uchin, huai ah nakpitak in na kipak uhi.
Na ginna uh ze-etna, dangka-eng mei a ze-et nung nangawn a mangthang zel sang a manphazaw, Jesu Khrist kilak chiang a phatna leh pahtawina leh thupina ding ahong hihtheihna ding in.
Mu ngei lou napi in amah na it ua, tu in mu tadih kei mah le uchin, amah na gingta ua, kipahna gen vual louh leh thupina a dim in na kipak mahmah uhi.
Na ginna un atup pen na kha uh hotdamna na mu uhi.
Huai hotdamna thu zawlneite hehpihna na kiang ua hong tung ding thugenkholte'n akankan ua, siamneltak in azongkhia uhi.
Khrist kha amau a om in Khrist thuakna ding leh thupina hon zui dingte atheihkholhsak lai in, bang hun a bangchi a hong tung ding ahia chih zonkhiak atum uhi.

Huai thu in amau nasep kisep lou in, noumau nasep asem zaw uh chih akiang uah theihsak ahita, huai thute van a kipan a sawlkhiak Kha Siangthou panpih in tanchinhoih nou hon hilhte'n tu in ahon hilh ua, huai thilte angelte'n leng vel a-ut uhi.
Huaiziak in na lungsim puan uh teng in pilvang unla, Jesu Khrist kilak chiang a hehpihna nou ahon puak ding lungke lou in lamen un.
heading: Khristian Omdan Siangthou

paite: Ta thumangte bang in, na theih louh lai ua na nidanglai duhgawlna uh bang a om lou in;
nou hon sampa asiangthou bang in nou leng na tatdan tengteng uah hong siangthou un;
"Noute na siangthou ding uh ahi, kei ka siangthou ngal a," chih gelh ahi.
Huan khentuam nei lou a michih nasep bang chiat a vaihawmpa Pa bang a na loh uleh, hiai lai a na taam lai teng un laudan siam in om un.
Na pipute uh piaksawn, na omdan uh bangmah hilou a kipan, thil se thei, dangka leh dangka-eng a tat na hi kei ua,
belamnou gensiatbei leh nin baang lou sisan bang a, Khrist sisan pha a tat na hi zaw uh chih na thei uhi.
Amah leilung pian ma in sehkholh in a-om ngeitak a, himahleh hun nanung ah noumau ziak in kilak in a-om hi.
Amah ziak in misi lak a kipan kaithoupa leh athupina pepa Pathian gingtate na hi uh, na ginna uh leh na lametna uh Pathian a a-omtheihna ding in.
Unaute it taktak ding a thutak zui a na kha uh na hihsiangthou tak ziak un lungtang a phatuamngaitak in ki-ittuah chiat un.
Chi se thei lak ah hilou in, Pathian Thu hing gige leh om gige chi setheilou lak a piangthak na hi zaw uhi.
"Mi tengteng loupa bang ahi ua, athupina uh leng loupa pak bang ahi. Loupa avuai a, apak apulh hi.
Toupa bel tangtawn in a-om gige hi," chih ahi ngal a. Hiai ahi tanchinhoih nou ahon hilh pen uh.
